records.label: Prioritize true catalog libraries first
records.details: Richelieu, Blum, Accuride, Fastenal and Grainger give strong catalog/index structures. Convert those before scraping ordinary retail pages.

records.label: Use Canadian Tire API path if possible
records.details: Canadian Tire has a developer program, so it is a higher-value target than brittle web scraping.

records.label: Separate local suppliers from master products
records.details: Gregg, Red Deer Bolt, Red Deer Fasteners and Bolt Supply Red Deer are local supplier/offer sources; product identity should still link to brand/part/spec records.

records.label: Use cabinet hardware as its own serious domain
records.details: Kitchen cabinets require hinges, slides, pulls, organizers, doors, panels, pulls, lift systems and application-specific specs such as overlay, bore, load and extension.

records.label: Normalize four row types
records.details: ProductIdentity, SupplierOffer, TechnicalSpecCatalog and ProcurementClassification should remain separate but linked.
